messages:
maria_partnerships: Quick heads-up — Nebula Cloud asked for a lightweight ref-arch + Terraform starter that wires Redwood Private into their managed K8s + customer VPC. They want a 1-button deploy for partner enablement docs and a tiny sample app. Target: demo at partner kickoff in 3 weeks.

sam_eng: 👍 can we reuse the slim starter modules from the marketplace repo and add a Nebula adapter?

maria_partnerships: That was my thought. Wanted to check constraints: Nebula needs private endpoint + KMS integration. Also they prefer our minimal operator flow vs full managed helm chart.

liz_docs: I can draft the quickstart and a 1-page diagram. Need exact terraform variables and example outputs to show in console screenshots.

toni_infra: For private endpoint + KMS we'll need a little extra infra glue — VPC peering or PrivateLink depending on Nebula tenancy model. I can sketch two variants. Which one do we prioritize?

alex_partner_eng: Nebula said they'd prefer PrivateLink-like model (no peering) for their marketplace model. They want the flow to be "customer subscribes -> infra deploys into partner account -> Redwood Private control plane connects via private endpoint".

sam_eng: OK — plan: fork slim-marketplace-iac, add nebula/adapter module that creates endpoint, k8s CRD for the tiny operator, and a sample app. I'll add an "examples/nebula" dir and a smoke test.

maria_partnerships: Timeline check: sam, can you own the module + PR? toni, you own infra variants doc. liz, docs and screenshots. Alex will triage partner feedback.

sam_eng: I can take module ownership. Estimated 10 dev hours + 4 hours for CI smoke. Will aim for an MVP PR in 5 business days.

toni_infra: I'll produce the two-variant decision doc by EOD Wednesday. Will include flow diagrams, required IAM, and network checklist.

liz_docs: I'll create the quickstart draft and the one-pager once sam posts the example outputs. ETA next Tue for screenshots + short commands.

alex_partner_eng: I can run early integration tests in Nebula tenant on Thursday if you push an alpha branch.

sam_eng: I'll push an alpha branch today with the minimal TF module and a README. Includes a sample terraform snippet:

```terraform
module "redwood_nebula_adapter" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/refkit.git//modules/nebula-adapter?ref=alpha"
  nebula_region = "us-east-1"
  redwood_private_endpoint = var.redwood_endpoint
  kms_key_arn = var.kms_key_arn
  customer_vpc_id = var.customer_vpc_id
}
```

sam_eng: CI will run a smoke apply against a lightweight emulated account (no real infra). ci-bot: please run the sandbox plan job when I push.

ci-bot: sandbox-plan triggered for branch sam/nebula-adapter-alpha — job queued.

maria_partnerships: Great. After alpha validation with Alex, we'll schedule a partner enablement session and finalize the marketplace listing assets. Also propose we add a small teardown script to avoid partner account costs during testing.

toni_infra: Noted — I'll add teardown steps and cost notes to the decision doc.

liz_docs: I'll also include a "troubleshooting" mini-section (common errors: endpoint not reachable, KMS permissions, operator crashloop).

sam_eng: Will link PR here when ready: https://github.com/redwood/refkit/pull/### — expecting by EOD.

alex_partner_eng: Thanks all — I have a sync with Nebula on Friday, will bring this plan and ask them to provision a stage tenant for Thursday tests. :thumbsup:

maria_partnerships: Awesome. Follow-ups: sam -> PR, toni -> infra doc, liz -> quickstart draft, alex -> partner test tenant. Check-in next Monday 9am PT. :calendar:
